notes:
1.1.6: master plan output/resources columns, clearer progress, progress from sub-activities, details before editing

- Plan view: Deliverable output and Required resources columns pinned on the right (toggle: Output & resources; off by default on phones)
- Progress: coloured % badges (grey not started, amber in progress, green complete), % label after each bar, darker done-fill
- Progress source per work package: sub-activities (duration-weighted, default when it has sub-activities), linked tasks, or by hand; exported to Excel as 'Progress from'
- Clicking a bar, diamond, name or column cell opens a read-only details sheet with Edit / + Task / Close
